title: A continuum of Künneth theorems for persistence modules
summary: We develop new aspects of the homological algebra theory for persistence modules, in both the one-parameter and multi-parameter settings. For a poset $P$ and an order preserving map $\varphi:P\times P\to P$, we introduce a novel tensor product of persistence modules indexed by $P$, $\otimes_{\varphi}$. We prove that each $\otimes_{\varphi}$ has a right adjoint, $\mathbf{Hom}^{\varphi}$, the internal hom of persistence modules that also depends on $\varphi$.
